name: WooCommerce AI Chatbot & Shopping Assistant – WoAssistCart AI
author: WoAssistCart

sections.description:
WoAssistCart AI is an all-in-one WooCommerce AI chatbot and AI shopping assistant designed to transform traditional store navigation into an interactive, conversational shopping experience.

By combining natural language AI with your WooCommerce catalog, WoAssistCart AI helps shoppers discover products, ask questions, compare items, get recommendations, manage their cart, and look up orders directly through an intelligent AI chat interface.

Instead of browsing endless categories or setting complex filters, store visitors can simply describe what they need and receive relevant product suggestions and conversational assistance.

Bring conversational e-commerce to your WooCommerce store using your preferred AI provider. WoAssistCart AI connects with OpenAI and Google Gemini using your own API key, giving you control over AI usage and costs without requiring a mandatory WoAssistCart cloud subscription.

Get WoAssistCart Pro | Try Live Demo

Key Highlights

  • AI Product Search: Help customers find WooCommerce products using natural-language requests instead of relying only on exact keyword matches.
  • WooCommerce AI Chatbot: Answer pre-purchase questions and provide product information through an interactive AI chat experience.
  • Product Recommendations: Suggest relevant products based on customer questions, preferences, and shopping intent.
  • Product Comparison: Help shoppers compare products and understand key differences before making a purchase.
  • Interactive Cart Assistant: Allow shoppers to add products, update quantities, and remove items directly inside the chat.
  • Instant Order Lookup: Help customers check order information and status without leaving the conversation.
  • Bring Your Own API Key: Connect directly to OpenAI or Google Gemini and maintain control over your AI provider and usage.

Free Features

AI Shopping Assistant

Add an AI-powered shopping assistant to your WooCommerce store using a floating chat widget or shortcode. Customers can interact with your store using natural language instead of navigating through multiple pages.

AI Product Search

Customers can describe what they are looking for in everyday language and receive relevant WooCommerce products. The assistant can understand requests involving product names, features, use cases, preferences, and shopping requirements.

Product Questions & Answers

Help customers get answers about your WooCommerce products using information available from your store. Customers can ask questions before purchasing and receive conversational assistance.

Product Recommendations

Recommend relevant products based on customer conversations and shopping intent. Help shoppers discover products that match their needs and preferences.

Product Comparison

Allow customers to compare products within the AI shopping conversation. This helps shoppers understand differences between products before making a purchase.

Cart Management

Customers can manage their WooCommerce cart through the AI assistant, including adding products, updating quantities, and removing items. Cart actions require customer confirmation.

Order Assistant

Help customers look up their WooCommerce orders and get order-related information through conversational interactions.

Quick Actions

Add up to 3 customizable Quick Actions to help customers quickly start common conversations or shopping tasks.

Brand Customization

OpenAI & Google Gemini

Connect your own API key from OpenAI or Google Gemini and use your preferred AI provider for conversational shopping.

Multilingual Support

Conversation Memory

Maintain conversational context so customers can continue a shopping conversation without repeatedly providing the same information.

AI Usage Controls

Optional token and usage controls help store owners manage AI usage and keep API costs under control.

Privacy & Security

The plugin is designed to keep AI provider communication under the store owner’s control. AI requests are sent to the provider configured by the site administrator.

Pro Features

WoAssistCart AI Pro adds advanced AI-powered WooCommerce shopping and sales features for stores that need deeper product discovery, customer engagement, automation, and analytics.

Get WoAssistCart Pro | Try Live Demo

Semantic & AI Product Search

Go beyond traditional keyword matching with meaning-based product discovery.

Customers can describe a need or use case instead of knowing the exact product name.

For example:

  • “Something comfortable for long flights”
  • “A laptop for coding that stays cool”
  • “A gift for someone who loves photography”

The AI can use the meaning and context of a request to help shoppers discover relevant products.

AI Sales Agent & Guided Selling

Guide customers through the buying process with conversational questions.

The AI Sales Agent can ask about requirements such as:

  • Intended use
  • Budget
  • Preferred features
  • Size or specifications
  • Customer preferences

It then uses the conversation to help shoppers find products that match their requirements.

Sales Playbooks

Create customized conversation strategies for different product categories.

For example:

  • Electronics — technical specifications and compatibility
  • Clothing — size, style, and occasion
  • Furniture — room dimensions and preferences

Sales Playbooks allow different product categories to use different guided-selling approaches.

AI Upsell & Cross-Sell

Recommend related products, complementary items, and potential upgrades based on the current shopping conversation.

For example, when a customer selects a camera, the assistant can recommend compatible accessories such as a camera bag, memory card, or spare battery.

Abandoned Cart Recovery

Create automated abandoned-cart recovery campaigns to help bring shoppers back to incomplete purchases.

Features include:

  • Multi-step recovery campaigns
  • Scheduled recovery emails
  • AI-assisted email copy
  • Branded email templates
  • Custom calls to action
  • Campaign scheduling

Back-in-Stock Alerts

Allow customers to request notifications when an out-of-stock product becomes available again.

Store owners can also use product interest information to better understand customer demand.

Analytics & Revenue Attribution

Understand how the AI shopping assistant contributes to store activity.

Track metrics such as:

  • AI conversations
  • Product searches
  • Product recommendations
  • Product interactions
  • Cart actions
  • Orders influenced by AI
  • Revenue attributed to AI-assisted shopping

Use analytics to understand how customers interact with the AI shopping experience.

AI Knowledge Base & RAG

Extend the assistant’s knowledge beyond standard WooCommerce product fields.

Add information such as:

  • Product manuals
  • Compatibility guides
  • Care instructions
  • Assembly instructions
  • Shipping information
  • Return policies
  • Store policies
  • Frequently asked questions

This is particularly useful for stores selling products that require detailed product or policy information.

Voice & Image Shopping

Enable additional ways for customers to interact with the shopping assistant.

Customers can use voice input for shopping requests and image-based product discovery where supported by the configured AI provider and Pro functionality.

Advanced Multilingual Capabilities

Provide a more localized conversational shopping experience for international customers with enhanced language handling and multilingual AI interactions.

Priority Support

Pro customers receive priority support and assistance with the product.

Free vs Pro

Free includes:

  • AI shopping assistant
  • WooCommerce AI chatbot
  • Natural-language product search
  • Product Q&A
  • Product recommendations
  • Product comparison
  • Cart management
  • Order assistance
  • Quick Actions
  • Brand customization
  • 11+ languages
  • OpenAI and Google Gemini support
  • Conversation memory
  • AI usage controls
  • Privacy and security features

Pro includes:

  • Semantic AI product search
  • AI Sales Agent
  • Guided selling
  • Sales Playbooks
  • AI upsell and cross-sell
  • Abandoned cart recovery
  • Back-in-stock alerts
  • Analytics and revenue attribution
  • AI Knowledge Base and RAG
  • Voice and image shopping
  • Advanced multilingual capabilities
  • Priority support

Upgrade to WoAssistCart Pro

External Services

WoAssistCart AI can communicate with third-party AI providers after the site administrator configures an API key.

The plugin currently supports OpenAI and Google Gemini.

The third-party provider selected by the site administrator may receive information required to process AI requests, such as customer messages, assistant instructions, and relevant WooCommerce product, cart, or order information.

Please review the applicable provider’s terms and privacy policy before enabling the service.

OpenAI

API Endpoint: https://api.openai.com

When Used: After the site administrator configures OpenAI and a customer interacts with the AI assistant.

Data Sent: Customer messages, assistant instructions, and relevant WooCommerce product, cart, or order information required for the AI request.

Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Gemini

API Endpoint: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com

When Used: After the site administrator configures Google Gemini and a customer interacts with the AI assistant.

Data Sent: Customer messages, assistant instructions, and relevant WooCommerce product, cart, or order information required for the AI request.

Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install WoAssistCart AI from Plugins → Add New or upload the plugin ZIP file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → WoAssistCart AI.
  5. Select your AI provider: OpenAI or Google Gemini.
  6. Enter your API key and test the connection.
  7. Enable the floating AI shopping assistant or add the assistant using a shortcode.
  8. Customize the assistant’s appearance and settings.

Available shortcodes:

[woassistcart-ai]

[woassistcart_ai_chat]
sections.faq:
What is WoAssistCart AI?

WoAssistCart AI is an AI shopping assistant and WooCommerce AI chatbot that helps customers search for products, ask product questions, compare products, get recommendations, manage their carts, and check orders through natural-language conversations.

Is WoAssistCart AI a WooCommerce plugin?

Yes. WoAssistCart AI is designed for WooCommerce stores and uses your store’s WooCommerce products, cart, and order information to provide AI-powered shopping assistance.

Does WoAssistCart AI work as a chatbot?

Yes. The plugin provides an AI chat interface that allows customers to communicate with your WooCommerce store using natural language.

Do I need an AI API key?

Yes. AI-powered functionality requires your own API key from either OpenAI or Google Gemini.

You can get an API key from:

  • OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/

Does WoAssistCart AI require a separate cloud account?

No mandatory WoAssistCart cloud account is required for the core AI functionality. You connect your own supported AI provider and API key.

How much do AI API requests cost?

AI API costs depend on the provider, model, usage, and number of customer conversations. WoAssistCart AI includes optional usage controls to help store owners manage AI usage.

Does the plugin send data to WoAssistCart?

The free plugin does not require customer conversations to be sent to WoAssistCart for AI processing. AI requests are sent to the AI provider configured by the site administrator.

See the External Services section for information about third-party AI providers.

Can AI change product prices or stock?

WooCommerce remains the source of truth for product prices, stock status, and product information. The AI assistant does not independently define WooCommerce prices or inventory.

Can customers add products to the cart through chat?

Yes. Customers can add products, update quantities, and remove products through the AI shopping assistant. Cart actions require confirmation.

Can customers compare WooCommerce products?

Yes. WoAssistCart AI can provide product comparison within the AI shopping conversation.

Can customers search products using natural language?

Yes. Customers can describe what they need in natural language and the assistant can help find relevant WooCommerce products.

Does it work with my WordPress theme?

The floating assistant is designed to work across WordPress themes. You can also use the shortcode when you need more precise placement in a page builder or content area.

What languages are supported?

WoAssistCart AI supports 11+ languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Bengali, Hindi, Chinese, and Japanese.

Can I customize the AI chatbot?

Yes. You can customize the assistant’s colors, avatar, greeting, launcher position, and Quick Actions.

How do I get WoAssistCart Pro?

Visit:

https://wooassistant.com/

Can I try WoAssistCart AI before upgrading to Pro?

Yes. Try the live demo:

https://wooassistant.com/demo/

Is WoAssistCart AI GDPR compliant?

The plugin includes features intended to support privacy requirements, including personal data export and erase support, conversation retention controls, and secure handling of stored API credentials.

Store owners are responsible for configuring their website, AI provider, privacy policy, consent mechanisms, and data processing practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
